prose: CM-J is an easy saber choreography for duelists to develop battling using an inverted grip. This CM allows Lumen A to focus on using an inverted grip and gives the option of having Lumen B either use standard grip or inverted group to make it a dazzling fight. CM-J is worth 2 points in LUMINA. To learn its notation and more about the SaberCraft system, please visit SaberCraft.org
body_text:
CM-J is an easy saber choreography for duelists to develop battling using an inverted grip. This CM allows Lumen A to focus on using an inverted grip and gives the option of having Lumen B either use standard grip or inverted group to make it a dazzling fight. CM-J is worth 2 points in LUMINA. To learn its notation and more about the SaberCraft system, please visit SaberCraft.org
